question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Unequivocal
solution:
The correct answer is Option (3) i.e. **Unambiguous**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Unequivocal: (स्पष्ट)** - Clearly expressed or leaving no doubt; unambiguous.

 
 
• **Example: **Her agreement was unequivocal.
 
 
 
• **Unambiguous: (असंदिग्ध)** - Clear and precise; having only one possible meaning or interpretation.
 
 
• **Example:** The instructions were unambiguous.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is Unambiguous.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Complete: (पूर्ण) **- Fully accomplished or having all necessary or normal parts.

 
 
• **Example: **The project is complete.
 
 
 
• **Articulate: (स्पष्ट रूप से बोलने वाला) **- Able to express thoughts and ideas clearly and effectively.
 
 
• **Example: **He was articulate in his speech.
 
 
 
• **Doubted: (संदेह किया)** - To feel uncertain about; question the truth or reliability.
 
 
• **Example:** She doubted his intentions.
